_about: MUSICALITY IDEAS — reusable systems and ways of hearing/dancing the music. NOT a song catalogue. The flagship system (CPE-8 + ROLA) lives in full in knowledge/musicality.md; entries here are the index/handles into it plus standalone ideas. id convention: mus-<slug>.

ideas.name: CPE-8 — the eight knobs of movement quality
ideas.short_description: Monotony comes from a CONSTANT movement-quality, not from too few figures. Vary the 8 knobs (Czas / Przestrzeń / Energia) instead of adding vocabulary. Even plain walking stops being monotonous if the quality varies.
ideas.when_to_use: Always — it's the base operating system for musicality. Especially when a dance feels flat despite 'enough figures'.
ideas.movement_quality: The knobs: Czas (speed, pauses, phrasing), Przestrzeń (size/Rozmiar, rotation, closeness), Energia (weight/lightness, tension, density).
ideas.phrase_or_section_logic: ONE change per phrase, max TWO per section. Fall back to the 'Neutral' preset if the follower loses readability.
ideas.risks_or_limits: Changing too many knobs at once = unreadable. The discipline IS the value.
ideas.notes: Patryk's own framework. The caminata is its perfect demonstrator.

ideas.name: ROLA — one role per section
ideas.short_description: Give each musical section a single one-word role (prezencja / napęd / szept / kulminacja / domknięcie…) and let that role govern the quality choices for the whole section.
ideas.when_to_use: Structuring a whole song; deciding the arc A-B-A-B-A.
ideas.phrase_or_section_logic: One ROLA per section; change of section = change of role = the big contrast. Within a section, stay in character (max two knob changes).
ideas.risks_or_limits: Switching role mid-section muddies the arc.

ideas.name: Quality presets (gears)
ideas.short_description: Pre-set quality combinations you shift between like gears: Neutral (small/soft/low-density), Rytmiczny, Płynny/legato, Zawieszony (pauses/suspense).
ideas.when_to_use: When you need to change quality fast and cleanly without thinking knob-by-knob — shift a whole gear at a section boundary.

ideas.name: Orchestra → character
ideas.short_description: Each orchestra/era carries a default dance character; match your quality and vocabulary to it. This is what transfers a sequence built on one song to another song of the same character.
ideas.phrase_or_section_logic: D'Arienzo / Biagi → rhythmic, driving, playful (staccato). Di Sarli / Fresedo → legato, elegant, romantic. Donato → playful, rhythmic, melodic. Pugliese → dramatic, dynamic. Troilo → lyrical, balanced. Canaro / De Caro → classic. Piazzolla → modern, rhythmic, dramatic.
ideas.when_to_use: Choosing what to dance for a tanda; deciding whether a known sequence fits a new song.
ideas.risks_or_limits: A guide, not a law — individual recordings vary; the specific song's energy overrides the orchestra's average.
ideas.notes: Drives the sequence index in figures.json (each sequence's `character` is inferred from its orchestra).
